title: Apply for Personal Hardship Assistance, Tropical Cyclone Alfred, March 2025
summary: Find out if you are eligible for Personal Hardship Assistance following Tropical Cyclone Alfred and learn how to apply.
intro:
If you lived in a property impacted by Tropical Cyclone Alfred (the disaster event) on 3 March 2025, you may be eligible for Personal Hardship Assistance.

This payment is to help pay for food, medication, clothing, temporary accommodation and other essential needs.

### Closing date

Applications are closed.
who_can_apply: Live in a disaster declared area (AGRN 1198) impacted by the disaster event on 3 March 2025.
Be impacted by the disaster event and require emergency financial assistance to meet immediate needs for yourself and any dependents.
Note: You are not eligible if you are living at an address concerning land acquired by the NSW Government under a buy-back scheme.
People under 18 cannot apply separately, but financially independent people under 18 may apply in person at an authorised Service NSW Centre or Mobile Service Centre.
what_you_need: Your Australian bank account details for payment.
One document (JPG, PDF, PNG, or TIF format) showing your name and impacted address.
For dependents: Names, Medicare numbers, and Medicare details of all included dependents.
Keep receipts for auditing: Keep evidence of how you spent the grant, including receipts, for a minimum of 5 years from the grant closing date.
contact:
For more information:

### Request an Internal Review of a decision about a grant application

If you do not agree with a decision we have made about your grant application, you can request an internal review.

faqs.q: Are applications for Personal Hardship Assistance still open?
Who is eligible to apply for this assistance?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over, live in a disaster declared area (AGRN 1198) impacted by the disaster event on 3 March 2025, and require emergency financial assistance for your immediate needs and those of any dependents.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need your Australian bank account details, a MyServiceNSW Account, and one document showing your name and impacted address.
